Path traced on the OLD tag's source: rpc-mode.ts:1166 `abort` -> agent-session.ts:7695 sets autoResumeSuppressed; the extension's pi.sendMessage(deliverAs:'aside', triggerTurn:true) from a timer (no RPC prompt scope) -> sendCustomMessage aside branch agent-session.ts:7242 folds into context and returns false -> runtime-init.ts invokingTask rejects 'send did not invoke the agent' -> RpcExtensionUserMessageTracker attaches no handler outside a prompt scope -> unhandledRejection.
